h1: Founding Client Program: 5 spots for home service businesses

sections.subheading: We’re focusing on home service businesses: garage door, tree services, roofing, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, fencing and remodeling. We’ve built 50+ websites across other industries, but we don’t have home service case studies yet. So we’re offering our first 5 home service clients a better deal in exchange for helping us build that proof.

sections.heading: What you get
list: Business plan features (normally $449/month) for $249/month for your first 6 months
Up to 10 pages, premium custom design, Google Business Profile management, priority updates
Lead capture and follow-up setup with our CRM, included at no extra cost for the first 6 months
A private preview of your new website before you pay anything
Direct access to Tejas G., our CTO

sections.heading: What we ask in return
list: Permission to share your website and real results (calls, form enquiries, rankings) in a case study
A short video or written testimonial after 90 days, only if you’re happy with the results

sections.heading: The terms
list: Month-to-month, no long-term contract, no activation fee. Cancel anytime.
After 6 months, you move to the standard Business plan ($449/month) or switch to Lite ($249/month). Your choice.
If you cancel, you owe us nothing further, including the testimonial.
After 6 consecutive paid months, the completed website is yours (same as our standard terms).

sections.heading: Who it’s for
list: Home service businesses in the US, UK or Canada
In one of the industries above
Ready for a new website within the next 30 days

sections.heading: Want one of the 5 founding spots?
sections.body: Start with a private preview of your new website before you pay anything.
